data.gender_notes: Jaleelun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is exalted and noble. A person of high moral character, esteemed and respected by all. The name Jaleelun carries the meaning “Exalted, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jaleelun usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Jaleelun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaleelun total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: جَليلٌ
in_arabic.long_meaning: جَليلٌ هو اسم علم مذكر يُستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية، ومعناه الجلال والكرامة والسمو، ويُشتق من الجذر العربي جَلَلَ، والذي يُقابل بالعظمة والقوة والسمو، وذكر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، ويشير إلى العظمة والقوة اللهية

in_urdu.name: جلیل
in_urdu.long_meaning: جلیل ایک مذکر نام ہے جو اسلامی ثقافت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا معنی عظمت و کرامت اور بلندی ہے، اور یہ عربي جذر جَلَلَ سے مشتق ہے، جو عظمت و قوت اور بلندی کے معنی دیتا ہے، اور اس کا تذکرہ قرآن پاک میں بھی ہے

in_hindi.name: जलील
in_hindi.long_meaning: जलील एक पुरुष नाम है जो इस्लामी संस्कृति में उपयोग किया जाता है, और इसका अर्थ महानता और सम्मान और उच्चता है, और यह अरबी मूल जَلَلَ से派生 है, जो महानता और शक्ति और उच्चता के अर्थ देता है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरान में भी है

in_pashto.name: جلیل
in_pashto.long_meaning: جلیل یو نوم دی چې په اسلامی کلتور کی کارول کیږي، او د هغه معنا لوړوالی او عزت او برتري دی، او دا د عربي ریښې جَلَلَ څخه اخیستل شوي دی، چې لوړوالی او قوت او برتري ته اشاره کوي، او دا په قرآن کريښته کې هم ذکر شوي دی

in_english.name: Jaleelun
in_english.long_meaning: Jaleelun is a male name used in Islamic culture, and its meaning is greatness and dignity and exaltation, and it is derived from the Arabic root جَلَلَ, which connotes greatness and power and exaltation, and it is mentioned in the Quran, and it signifies the greatness and power of Allah

data.cultural_impact: The name Jaleelun holds significant cultural impact as it communicates a heightened sense of pride, respect, and honor in Arabic and Islamic cultures. It is a prestigious name that resonates with a rich tradition of valor and ethical behavior, especially for men in Arab and Islamic societies. A person bearing this name is expected to live up to its noble meaning by embodiment of noble character, virtuous behavior, and moral autonomy. This name can be associated with not only individuals, but also with royalty, noble families, and noble institutions reflecting the profound respect and reverence for noble and virtuous individuals in their societies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Jaleelun represents an identifier of one's deep connection to God and the moral values that He holds dear. It signifies humility, empathy, patience, love, and respect for self and others. A person with this name is called to live a life worthy of the name's meaning and to continuously strive to embody the spiritual qualities of a noble character. The name Jaleelun is a reminder of one's spiritual mission, responsibility, and the importance of ultimately seeking God's pleasure and approval in all aspects of life. Overall, the name Jaleelun holds a powerful symbolic meaning reflecting a connection between the spiritual and ethical dimensions of one's being in the Islamic worldview.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jaleelun was the name of the Abbasid Caliph Al-Mansur, who ruled from 754 to 775 AD. The name Jaleelun carried significant weight in that era.
